title: Power equivariance of the integral-reduced positive finite root chart
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], its algebraically closed base field k, coefficient ring A and exponent N = ell^n. For every k-scheme T, natural numbers d,a, and primitive N-th roots zeta, eta in k with zeta = eta^a, let t_zeta(d) and t_eta(d) be the derived integral-reduced positive charts of [def-pur-finite-positive-root-charts]. Then t_eta(d).hom = a^d times t_zeta(d).hom, where multiplication is repeated addition in the derived module-sheaf category. No finite-type, connectedness or boundedness hypothesis is imposed; d = 0 and empty schemes are included.

source.place: Step 2, compatibility with the invertible twist by associativity of derived tensor; expanded root-chart normalization in def-pur-finite-root-tensor-presentation.

proof.text: The section formula for the ordinary root trivialization gives q_zeta = a*q_eta. Inverting gives the opposite-direction first-chart equation t_eta = a*t_zeta. The first-site comparison and unit comparison are root-independent. Additive single realization and full faithfulness, using the specified first-sheaf-chart normalization, give this equation for the ordinary first charts.

Work on a pro-etale trivializing cover with a coherent signed frame whose first generator is the root generator. The root generator for zeta is a times the one for eta; its ordered d-th tensor is a^d times the one for eta. The normalization defining the positive ordinary chart sends each corresponding generator to one. On the eta generator this implies chart_eta = a^d*chart_zeta. Equality on the generator extends linearly and glues by the sheaf axiom. At zero the generator is coefficient one and the scalar is a^0=1. The additive single functor and fixed unit comparison preserve the equality, proving the derived formula.

proof_origin.source: Explicit calculation of the prescribed root-chart power law from the existing section and ordered-basis normalizations.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteTensorPositiveChart_pow (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] (d a : ℕ)
    (ζ η : P.field.k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ P.diagonalExponent)
    (hη : IsPrimitiveRoot η P.diagonalExponent) (h : ζ = η ^ a) :
    (P.finiteTensorPositiveChart T η hη d).hom =
      a ^ d • (P.finiteTensorPositiveChart T ζ hζ d).hom
